name: candidate_grand
text: At the far end of the battlefield... Surtr raises his sword of flame. Defeat him... before the world burns.
instruct: A mature male narrator with a deep, resonant bass-baritone voice, a weathered grain and a clear British English accent. An ancient storyteller proclaiming a Norse saga. Solemn authority, dark grandeur, emotionally committed theatrical delivery. Deliberate phrasing with meaningful silence. Keep the same vocal identity throughout. Clear consonants and natural breaths. Rise to a commanding, impassioned warning. A broad, powerful final phrase, then a decisive falling cadence. Do not rush or yell.
